hooks.command: if git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^(main|master)'; then echo 'BLOCK: Do not commit directly to main.' >&2; exit 1; fi

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$BRANCH" == feat/* ]]; then MODULE=$(echo $BRANCH | sed 's|feat/[0-9]*-||; s|feat/||'); if [[ ! -f ".plans/${MODULE}.md" ]]; then echo "BLOCK: You must create .plans/${MODULE}.md BEFORE modifying Python files." >&2; exit 1; fi; fi
